lines.text: Why you should never buy a festival ticket from an Instagram ad.
In 2017, famous models promoted Fyre Festival, a luxury party in the Bahamas.
It promised luxury villas and gourmet meals.
VIP packages with flights cost twelve thousand dollars.
But when the guests arrived, they found disaster-relief tents and soaking-wet mattresses.
And dinner was a cheese sandwich in a foam box!
By the next morning, the festival was called off, and guests were sent back to Miami.
Its founder pleaded guilty to fraud and got six years in prison.
Would you have bought a ticket?
